title: Townline curation kit and exec brief - Q1 alignment week (draft)
summary: Working kit for curating the townline and exec briefing for Q1 alignment week. Purpose: make the all-hands crisp, surface top 3 company priorities, validate OKR language across orgs, and rehearse run-of-show + Q&A handling.
audience: Founders, execs, engineering leads, product, go-to-market leads, company-ops owners
objectives: Surface and finalize top 3 company objectives for Q1
Agree on the rollouts and owner-level KR thresholds to communicate
Produce a 35-minute all-hands run-of-show and a 20-minute deputy track for managers
Create an exec talk-track cheat sheet + contingency fallback lines
okrs_draft:
O1: Make inference predictable and inexpensive at scale
KR1.1: Reduce median hosted API p50 latency by 15% vs baseline (baseline = Nov 2025)
KR1.2: Cut per-token cost on common 8k-seq workloads by 18% via batching and quantization profiles

O2: Expand enterprise-ready footprints (Dedicated & Private)
KR2.1: Close 3 Dedicated contracts with >$200k ARR committed capacity
KR2.2: Ship VPC private deploy quickstart + KMS integration by end of Q1

O3: Platform reliability and developer trust
KR3.1: 99.9% uptime SLA for Dedicated pools
KR3.2: Ship latency and cost per-route dashboard in Redwood Console (beta) and enroll 5 customers in pilot
run_of_show: 0:03 - 0:10: Company priorities deep-dive (VP Product) — 7 min (3 objectives + 1 example per objective)
0:10 - 0:18: Customer story + impact (Customer Success + Customer rep) — 8 min
0:18 - 0:25: Reliability & roadmap highlight (SRE + Eng lead) — 7 min
0:35 - 0:50: Optional manager breakout (managers only) — 15 min handbook + distribution of responsibilities
facilitation_notes: Keep the narrative problem-first: start with customer pain (latency/cost) -> what we shipped -> measurable impact -> what we ask of the org. Use one tight slide per objective (title, metric, owner, next step). For Q&A: route tactical infra questions to SRE channel and roadmap questions to product office. Use 'we don't have an answer yet' + commitment to follow-up for any unanswered hard metric asks.
escalation_plan: If an exec cannot attend: pre-record talk + designate deputy. If live demo fails: fallback to recorded demo and 2-minute explainer. If significant outage occurs within 48h of all-hands: propose postponement and send an 'all-staff urgent status' memo instead.
rehearsals: Dry-run 1: 2026-02-09 10:00-11:00 (full execs + AV) - confirm slides and transitions
Dry-run 2: 2026-02-11 09:00-09:30 (founder + two leads) - tight timing run

open_questions: Do we want to show raw latency percentile charts or summarized delta bars? (tradeoff: transparency vs noise)
Which dedicated contracts (names) are okay to mention in public remarks? legal clearance required.
Manager breakout: will teams be required to commit to specific sprint actions, or keep it optional?
audience_prework_tips: Ask leads to prepare one slide with: 1) current KR status (RAG), 2) one risk, 3) one ask. Keep slides to title+3 bullets. Send template and due date (2026-02-05).
notes_to_self: Keep it short. Rehearse handoffs between founders and product tightly (no more than 15s mic swaps). Use two moderators: one chat/Q&A triage and one timing guard. Remember to call out wins vs metrics — avoid deep technical tangents unless invited.
